description: Combine or replace video and audio streams. Takes a video file and an audio track, with optional audio delay offset, stream-copy mode for zero quality loss, and 'replace' or 'add' stream mapping.

audioOffsetSeconds.description: Audio delay or advance in seconds. Positive numbers delay audio; negative numbers advance it. Default: 0.

audioPath.description: Path to the source audio file (.mp3, .wav, .aac, .m4a, etc.) to mux.

hardwareAcceleration.description: Use hardware-accelerated video encoding when streamCopyVideo is false. Default: true.

mode.description: Muxing mode: 'replace' drops existing video audio and uses new audio; 'add' keeps original audio and adds new audio as secondary track. Default: 'replace'.

shortest.description: End output when the shorter input stream finishes. Default: true.

streamCopyVideo.description: Use stream copy (-c:v copy) for instantaneous video multiplexing without quality loss. Default: true.

videoPath.description: Path to the source video file.

name: mux_media
